subject: Myth & Symbolism
subcategory: The World Tree and Cosmic Maps
title: The Final Frontier
description: A quick win: understand The Final Frontier.

hook.text: Space is the new 'here be dragons.' We've mapped the earth, so the edge of the world moved to the cosmos.

buildup.text: Star Trek called space 'the final frontier.' Elon Musk calls Mars the next home. The mythic edge keeps moving.

discovery.text: The observable universe has an edge: the cosmic microwave background. Beyond it, we cannot see. The wall returned.

twist.text: We may never reach the edge of the universe. Like the mythic horizon, it recedes as we approach.

climax.text: The edge of the world isn't a place—it's a concept. Wherever knowledge stops, myth fills the gap.

punchline.text: The edge moves. We follow. It never ends.
